name: nEDM — axion dark matter searches
full_name: ILL and PSI neutron Electric Dipole Moment axion searches
summary: Neutron electric-dipole-moment data are used to search for axion-induced oscillating electric dipole moments and axion-wind spin precession, extending tests of axion–gluon and axion–nucleon couplings.
detection_principle: Comparisons of ultracold-neutron and mercury-199 comagnetometer spin-precession frequencies search for electric-field-correlated oscillating electric dipole moments and time-dependent axion-wind responses.

status.label: The documented historical experimental phase is complete
status.evidence: ETH's official description states that the former PSI nEDM finished taking data in 2017. This record covers dark-matter analyses of the historical ILL/PSI apparatus; the successor n2EDM is not assumed to have completed the same searches.

timeline.event: Search for Axionlike Dark Matter through Nuclear Spin Precession in Electric and Magnetic Fields

phases.name: Sussex-RAL-ILL
phases.description: Data from the former ILL apparatus provide a longer time baseline.

phases.name: PSI nEDM
phases.description: The upgraded apparatus adds sensitivity to shorter periods; the full data-taking campaign ended in 2017.

results.summary: No axion dark-matter signal; direct laboratory axion–gluon coupling limits were obtained and some nucleon-coupling constraints improved.

science_scope: Directly searches for Galactic-halo axions, axionlike particles or other ultralight dark matter. Limits depend on assumed local density, velocity distribution and coupling models; separate scanned mass intervals do not amount to exclusion of the entire range.
